# Gemfield Consulting

> Gemfield Consulting builds and runs digital systems for restaurants, bars and taphouses in the United States: fast phone-first websites, a menu control panel the owner updates themselves, live table booking, missed-call text back, review systems, Google and Yelp listing management, online ordering the restaurant keeps the margin on, POS connection, and transparent reporting through the Deskii control panel. Based in San Francisco, CA.

Key facts:
- Positioning: "Your website should fill tables, not just exist."
- Gemfield serves restaurants, bars and taphouses only. It does not serve other industries.
- The website build is included with monthly plans.
- Plans: Front Door $197/month, Foundation $497/month, Growth $997/month, Scale from $1,497/month, Strategic from $3,500/month (scoped per group, no list price). Prices are published openly.
- Time to live: Front Door and Foundation one week from signing, Growth two weeks, Scale four weeks, Strategic six weeks.
- From Foundation up the restaurant changes its own menu from a phone, in under a minute, through the menu control panel.
- Foundation adds a table selector (a top-down plan of the room the guest books from) and a booking manager. Growth adds live availability, a chat assistant, missed-call text back and a review engine. Scale adds online ordering the restaurant owns, POS connection or a new POS built, and a guest database.
- On online ordering, the restaurant pays card processing of roughly 3 percent through its own payment account instead of an aggregator commission of 15 to 30 percent.
- POS: Square, Toast, Clover, Lightspeed and most systems built in the last decade have a documented way to connect. Gemfield checks the restaurant's POS for free before any commitment and gives a straight answer: yes, yes with a delay, or no. If it cannot connect, a POS is built, included at Scale and Strategic.
- All plans are month-to-month: no long-term contracts. Clients own their domain, content, photos, guest data, and the build itself after six paid months.
- Deskii is the control panel where clients change the menu, manage bookings, see conversations and reviews, and read the monthly report.
- Gemfield does not run social media, answer the phone, write menus, set prices, or place restaurants on delivery apps.
- Primary offer: a call. Gemfield reviews the site, the menu, the listings and the booking path beforehand, and checks the POS for free.
